capacity_buckets_policy.name: capacity_buckets_policy
capacity_buckets_policy.value: (policy_kind='limited' AND capacity>=0) OR (policy_kind IN ('missing','disabled','unlimited') AND capacity IS NULL)

example_customers_email.name: example_customers_email
example_customers_email.value: length(email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND email LIKE '%@%'

example_customers_company.name: example_customers_company
example_customers_company.value: company IS NULL OR length(btrim(company)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120

billing_price_values.name: billing_price_values
billing_price_values.value: amount >= 0 AND currency ~ '^[a-z]{3}$' AND interval IN ('month','year')

quota_values.name: quota_values
quota_values.value: consumed>=0 AND reserved>=0 AND period_end>period_start AND (capacity IS NULL OR capacity>=0) AND policy_kind IN ('missing','disabled','limited','unlimited')

usage_event_quantity.name: usage_event_quantity
usage_event_quantity.value: quantity<>0 AND (quantity>0 OR correction_of IS NOT NULL) AND dimensions='{}'::jsonb AND metric='projects.created' AND metric_version=1

file_available_identity.name: file_available_identity
file_available_identity.value: state<>'available' OR object IS NOT NULL
